newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK-INDEX UP, FIRST NATIONAL BUSY.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK-INDEX UP, FIRST NATIONAL BUSY.

text.p: First National Bank of Namibia, which listed in March afer a share offer of N$3.80 a share, was active in the week to June 27.
Institutions and others bought neary 1.3 million shares and pushed the price up from Monday's N$4.00 to N$4.50 by Thursday.
The total value of all shares traded on the bourse was N$14.6 million, made up of a volume of 2.30 million shares, the Namibian Stock Exchange officials said.
The NSE Overall Index climbed to close at 269.41 from the previous Friday's finish of 263.64.
The NSE local index also climbed strongly and ended the week at 173.93 from 168.72.
Other busy shares included Metropolitan Life which
traded 708,000 shares on Tuesday and Kolusus which came
to life towards the end of the week and traded 133,000 shares.
Local wholesale, packaging and agency group CIC
Holdings traded only on Friday at prices ranging from
N$2.95 to N$3.00. Namibia Breweries traded on four days
with the price mostly steady at N$3.50 but on Tuesday as low as
Sentra traded 20,450 shares at N$5.25 a share.
